reason: The loop guardian writes one closure receipt and stops asserting once every assertion holds for three consecutive sweeps. It closed on 2026-10-13 and was re-run on 2026-10-15 with all five assertions still passing, so the task firing it had nothing left to fire for. A task that references a script that no longer exists is silently absent work, which is the same failure the watch census exists to catch.
